final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_albumin_minus_protein, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_albumin_minus_protein) AS avg_albumin_minus_protein, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM step1 GROUP BY SEX), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS overall_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.SEX, s2.avg_albumin_minus_protein, s2.avg_aptt_minus_pt, s2.avg_aptt_minus_pt - s3.overall_avg_aptt_minus_pt AS excess FROM step2 AS s2 CROSS JOIN step3 AS s3 WHERE s2.avg_aptt_minus_pt > s3.overall_avg_aptt_minus_pt) SELECT AVG(avg_albumin_minus_protein), AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt), AVG(excess) FROM step4
